title: Context.dev web data
description: Search the web and news, read pages, answer questions, and retrieve brand data with Context.dev.

environment.name: CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY
environment.description: The function calls Context.dev with this API key, which needs data:execute access. Keep it on the server.

environment.name: CONTEXT_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Callers send this random token of at least 32 characters as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The function requires it because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Search the web
operations.description: POST a query to find current source URLs. You can set numResults to a number from 1 to 10.

operations.title: Read a web page
operations.description: POST an HTTP or HTTPS URL to get up to 50,000 characters of Markdown and source metadata for the page.

operations.title: Answer a web question
operations.description: POST a task to get a sourced answer. It uses fast mode unless you set mode to ultra.

operations.title: Retrieve a brand
operations.description: POST a domain to get the company's identity, logo, colors, and social links.

operations.title: Search news
operations.description: POST a query or a company domain to find news articles. Pass the returned cursor to get the next page.
